Fast plain floor 12.50 = the reach term alone; 11.88 configs (J3MIN -112.8..-113.4) admit one pose with the stop 0.17-0.46 deg from it - rejected as tuned (on exact that pose class is 203 at 0.72 mm / 205 at -4.28 mm). Exact: knee 59.3-105.9 deg (held 59.3-107.1), margins 11.4/13.2 mm in d (lead 0.33), d_perp >= 83.5 mm (12.0 N per N m vs lead 31.6), q3' taken [-109.2,116.1] (held [-111.16,119.44]: stop 0.74 deg from a held taken pose), 356 fit-clip frames 0 cut; the upper stop is inert on exact (316 below it). Columns: spec one-sided (proposer, same code) 18.36/22.79; CMA one-sided (lE 101, lc 31.2) 18.84/23.90 (20 held contacts, 9 by pad/knee at elev 15 extreme rotation - the fast bench cannot bound the knee's size); row best at the lead's stk 4.85: knee-E clash on 329 poses (invalid). Stop sizing: dowel 133 N per N m, 440C single shear ~3.4 kN (x2.6 at 10 N m), groove bearing 0.67 GPa at 10 N m; knee MR63ZZ pairs 110-125 N at 10 N m (at/above C0r, fine at the 2-5 N m cuff-slip limit). Per-pose dumps and the paired comparison in docs/alignment/remeasure/. | VERIFIED 2026-10-17T17:20:07Z (skeptic, local exact, frozen protocol): Bench(110,360) exact 18.28 (reach 0.7278, follow 1.0, ib14 0.9012, ib10 0.5739, contact 0.0106) and held 22.38 reproduced exactly (per-pose dumps identical); flood full 18.28 / knn 19.97; lead checks 0 failing poses, th margin 5.181 / 5.006; the stop acts on J3's own angle (C1) and fits a 250.7 deg groove (C2).
